newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina to import 10 mln kl fuel products.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina to import 10 mln kl fuel products.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina said on Monday it will import about 10 million kiloliters of fuel products in fiscal 1997/98 (April-March), up from an estimated seven million kiloliters in 1996/97.

"In 1997/98 domestic fuel product production is expected to be around 40.9 million kiloliters, while consumption will be 50.9 million kiloliters. So in 1997/98 there is a need to import around 10 million kiloliters," Pertamina director of supply Judosumardjo told reporters.
"Imports will be mainly diesel and kerosene," he said without giving further details.
Another Pertamina official said domestic fuel product consumption was estimated at 47.6 million kiloliters in 1996/97.
He said diesel oil consumption was expected to rise to 20.8 million kiloliters in fiscal 1997/98 from an estimated 19.2 million kiloliters in 1996/97.
Kerosene consumption was expected to rise to 9.9 million kiloliters in 1997/98 from 9.3 million kiloliters, the official said.
